name: setup-manaflow-ai-overdrive-look
description: A whole cmux look built only from public surfaces: theme files for color (Overdrive, dark, the default; Overdrive Daylight), settings for a tight bold chat face, a roomy sidebar and fast motion, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens that draws the prompt as a big round pink pill with a cyan rim, and a customize view for a score-card hover card and heavy sidebar rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Overdrive sidebar" },
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Overdrive's hover card and sidebar rows: status first like a score card, heavy names and a pulsing dot while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}

files.themes/overdrive.json:
// Overdrive: near-black with a violet cast, hot pink as the accent (Send, the selected row,
// links), electric cyan for work in progress, floating round panes with a gap between them.
{
  "name": "Overdrive",
  "description": "Near-black, hot pink and electric cyan, floating round panes, fast motion.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#0b0a12", "foreground": "#f6f2ff", "selection": "#3b1838", "accent": "#ff3d8b" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #0b0a12",
    "foreground = #f6f2ff",
    "cursor-color = #2ee6ff",
    "cursor-text = #0b0a12",
    "selection-background = #3b1838",
    "selection-foreground = #f6f2ff",
    "palette = 0=#1a1726",
    "palette = 1=#ff4d6d",
    "palette = 2=#3df5a7",
    "palette = 3=#ffd23d",
    "palette = 4=#4d8bff",
    "palette = 5=#ff3d8b",
    "palette = 6=#2ee6ff",
    "palette = 7=#d9d4e8",
    "palette = 8=#5a5470",
    "palette = 9=#ff7088",
    "palette = 10=#72ffc0",
    "palette = 11=#ffe270",
    "palette = 12=#7aa8ff",
    "palette = 13=#ff70a8",
    "palette = 14=#70efff",
    "palette = 15=#ffffff"
  ],

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",

  // Round panes floating over the window with a gap: chunky, separate pieces.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "floating",
  "appearance.borders": "default",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "both",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 38,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 264,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 40,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 36,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 13,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 8,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 2,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#07060d",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#0b0a12",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#0b0a12",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#2a1f3d",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "card",

  // Work in progress is a cyan dot that pulses, a size up and heavy.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.animation": "animated",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.color": "#2ee6ff",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.size": 1.25,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.thickness": 2.5,
  "appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWorkingOnTabs": true,

  // Snappy: color changes land in 90 ms on a spring.
  "ui.animationSpeed": "fast",
  "appearance.colorTransition.enabled": true,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "spring",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 90,
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "oklab",
  "appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion": "instant"
}
